name: Desktop Circular Rechargeable Fan with 360° Adjustable Airflow | Model QL-02 | Quiet Personal Cooling Fan for Home, Office & Bedroom | Random Color
description:
Stay cool and comfortable wherever you are with the Desktop Circular Rechargeable Fan. Designed with a compact circular body and powerful airflow technology, this portable desk fan delivers refreshing cooling while operating quietly for uninterrupted work, study, or sleep. Featuring 5 wind speed modes, 100-level stepless speed adjustment, a 360° adjustable stand, and a smart digital display, it allows you to customize your cooling experience with ease. Powered by a built-in rechargeable battery and USB charging, this lightweight fan is perfect for desks, bedrooms, offices, dorm rooms, and travel.

Compact circular desktop fan with modern design
Powerful airflow with high-speed motor
5 wind speed modes for customized cooling
100-level stepless speed adjustment
360° adjustable stand for multi-angle airflow
Quiet operation for work, study, and sleep
Built-in rechargeable battery for cordless use
USB rechargeable via laptop, power bank, or adapter

Lightweight and portable for home, office, and travel

Press the power button to switch on the fan
Adjust the wind speed to your preferred level

Brushless High-Speed Motor

Electronic Control Components
